title: Notion Page Edit Word Count Leaderboard
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=notion:page word_count=*
| stats sum(word_count) as total_value, avg(word_count) as avg_value by database_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks database values by total and average word count across Notion page edit events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `word_count` values for each Notion page edit event and review total and average word count by database.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total word count.
grandmaExplanation: It rates which database shows the biggest word count numbers in your Notion page edit data.
